cc:Work.dc:description:
Stackable storage for hobby paint or other things
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes PaintStorage --x 100 --y 180 --canheight 40 --candiameter 30 --minspace 10 --drawer 1 --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes PaintStorage --y --canheight --drawer --reference --labels
